title: Pure Fabled
summary: Fabled cards only, with generic staples. Fabled monsters want to be discarded: Lurrie and Cerburrel summon themselves, Krus revives another Fabled, and Marcosia searches a Fabled Spell/Trap. The 2025 cards lead. The Fabled Behilmoth discards itself with other Fabled monsters to summon the Fabled Synchro whose Level equals their total, straight from the Extra Deck. Fabled Gammajin, a Level 4 Synchro Tuner, then summons another Fabled from the Deck. Fabled Realm's Revival sets a Fabled Spell/Trap, stops the opponent from responding to Fabled Synchro Summons, and turns each discard into a draw or a revival. Fabled Levilazebul tributes Fabled monsters to steal that many of the opponent's.
